purpose: Teach: 水害/カラフル/陰陽/大連/一眼/絹/敷居/ベーコン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが水害ボランティアに参加されるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to help with the flood relief volunteering.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Gentle opening. Natural pause between name and information. Steady, unhurried pace—this is news to share but not alarm. Quiet presence of care underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、カラフルな絵を描いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I drew a really colorful picture!
lines.style: Bright, eager onset. Rush of excitement in the opening. Quick pace, words tumbling slightly. Seeking approval—eyes up. Genuine joy, not performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが陰陽道のお話してくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa told me the most interesting story about yin and yang.
lines.style: Warm, reflective tone. Slower pacing—inviting him into something meaningful. Slight lift on 'interesting' as if sharing a small treasure. Genuinely delighted to pass it on.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、社会で大連という街を勉強したよ
lines.en: Mom, we learned about a city called Dalian in social studies today.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pride. Earnest, straightforward delivery—wants to share something learned. Medium pace, careful pronunciation of 'Dalian.' Genuine interest in what he's discovered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが一眼カメラを買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father bought a real camera for us.
lines.style: Gentle excitement just beneath the surface. Warm pacing. Slight emphasis on 'real'—it's a meaningful thing. Reflective, as if she's noticing her son will see the world differently now.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お母さんの絹のドレス見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw your silk dress!
lines.style: Bright, almost hushed wonder. Quick excited intake. Childlike appreciation—he noticed something beautiful. Slightly breathless, as if he's just discovered something special.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家の敷居を磨きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's polish the threshold of the house together, shall we?
lines.style: Calm, gentle invitation. Even pacing. Matter-of-fact instruction that carries warmth—this is a small task done together. Quiet presence of togetherness in the 'shall we.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとベーコンエッグ食べたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I had bacon and eggs together!
lines.style: Bright, warm closure. Quick eager onset. Pure happiness in the recounting—he's sharing a small, perfect moment. Slight trailing lift at the end, as if waiting for her to share in the joy.
